text: Do not recommend.  Car-part has shown an engine in stock for a year that I had been watching while I pulled my old engine. Claims 90,000 miles. Went to look at it and they said it just came in a few days ago which was clearly a lie. They then said they had another one they just got a few days ago with 100,000 in it. I need a Ford 4.6 and both had 5.4 manufacturer tags. One had an 8 bolt flywheel when mine is a 6, but they continued to claim it was a 4.6. They said you cant go off of the MANUFACTURER'S tags and that they were certain it was a 4.6. They clearly didn't have the 90,000 mile 4.6 and were trying to pass off 5.4s to make a sale. This was after calling to verify they had it and driving over an hour to see it. Complete bait and switch scam and will not be back.

Do not believe mileage on any engines or transmissions they sell they lie about mileage I’ve personally caught them in a lie about mileage and if you don’t believe me what a coincidence that every single thing they sell online or on carpart.com no matter how old it is always under 90k miles but yet no proof when asked about it and when you show up to the location and ask to see the car they won’t let you they say there’s no time for someone to go show it to you but that’s all lies they don’t want you to see the mileage on the car like I did. Was told it’s a engine with 100k miles and when I acted like I needed something else to be able to go to the back to go look at the car the speedometer read 245k miles so avoid this place and save your money

Typical bait and switch, probably the same transmission just trying to get more money from us. Do not recommend. Wasted hours trying to buy from them.

Very bad service. Ordered a transmission on a Tuesday and they immediately charged my credit card. I did not receive by Friday so I called to inquire about where it was. They called at 3:57 pm with tracking #.  Too late. Why would a good company charge a credit card before an item is ready to be shipped.

I bought a 330i bmw motor from these guys. Paid TOP DOLLAR for a low mileage motor. They pull it and its covered in carbon. The guy fast talked me into it saying "oh its low mileage maybe i swear, maybe they didnt change their oil." I shouldnt have bought it. Then they broke the intake manifold with the straps on the fork lift when loading it. I myself had to go pull the manifold off another car. After selling me a questionable motor at a premium price I asked do you need my core? He looked down at the manifold i just removed and said, no man dont worry its about. Sympathizing with me maybe ?

Finally install the motor after resealing it. Has LOUD lifter tick on cold start. As well as misfire on cold start. Consistant slow cooling loss with no visible coolant leaks. Maple syrup smell on cold start. Check car after sitting while hot, with bore scope, in cylinder, and Confirm coolant entering cyl 5. Leak down test and block test also confirmed.

Bad head gasket .

Then they say,  I voided my warranty because I did not return a core! On the phone, when initially asking information on their warranty they said they DID NOT need the core., in the store, the day i bought it they told me "dont worry about it" , After telling them the car had a bad head gasket they said that

I VOIDED  my warranty because I did not bring my old core. Then they said read your receipt. There in the FINE PRINT it says, no core no warranty. The man asked to bring the car to be checked.
However at this point they have proven un trust worthy.

Do NOT trust their word.

Avoid at ALL cost.
